# SyncBeats

> Turn every phone, tablet, and laptop in the room into a synchronized surround sound system. Free, ultra-low latency, running entirely in your browser with zero app installation.

## Overview

SyncBeats (https://www.syncbeats.in) is a web-based multi-device audio synchronization platform. It coordinates audio playback across multiple hardware devices in real time with sub-25 millisecond precision. By synchronizing each device's Web Audio buffer against an adaptive Network Time Protocol (NTP) master clock, SyncBeats turns ordinary smartphones, tablets, and computers into a unified multi-speaker sound system.

## Primary Use Cases

- **Pocket Sound System (House Parties & Outdoor Gatherings)**: Place multiple smartphones on tables, counters, or across the room to create a wide, balanced soundstage that is louder and clearer than a single portable Bluetooth speaker.
- **Long-Distance Listening Parties**: Friends, couples, or study groups stream music together in real-time. Audio plays directly from each user's local hardware without the severe lossy compression or delay of Discord, Zoom, or FaceTime screenshares.
- **Desktop Spatial Audio Stage**: Arrange personal devices (MacBook in center, iPhone on the left, iPad on the right) and pan audio channels on the 3D spatial stage for an immersive surround sound workstation.
- **Silent Discos & Dance Rehearsals**: Dancers and listeners connect their own headphones or earbuds, hearing the exact same microsecond count without expensive RF headphone transmitter gear.

## Key Features

- **Sub-25ms Precision Synchronization**: Uses an adaptive 4-timestamp NTP burst algorithm combined with continuous Web Audio API hardware drift compensation.
- **Zero App Installation**: Runs seamlessly in Safari (iOS / macOS), Chrome (Android / Desktop), Edge, and Firefox. No app store downloads or complicated Bluetooth pairing required.
- **Multi-Source Audio**:
  - Direct YouTube search and streaming within rooms.
  - Spotify public playlist import and automatic high-fidelity matching.
  - Peer-to-peer WebRTC and local file drag-and-drop (MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC).
- **3D Spatial Soundstage**: Drag-and-drop speaker nodes to distribute left, center, right, and ambient channels across devices.
- **Real-Time Synced Lyrics**: Millisecond-accurate word and line highlighting synchronized to the beat.
- **Dynamic Island Control Interface**: Floating room controller for queue management, volume sliders, device latency readouts, and track search.
- **Private Rooms & Host Controls**: Lock rooms with one tap to require host approval before new participants can join.
- **Upcoming Native macOS Companion**: A native macOS app with menu bar quick controls, system-wide audio broadcasting (stream directly from Spotify Desktop, Apple Music, Ableton Live, or DJ software), and sub-15ms CoreAudio synchronization.

## How to Join or Create a Room

1. Visit https://www.syncbeats.in
2. Click "Start a Free Room" or enter a 6-digit room code in the join box.
3. Share the room link or QR code with nearby friends or remote listeners.
4. Search a song or import a playlist, press play, and all speakers play in synchronized harmony.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, Web Audio API, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Socket.IO, Express, Redis Adapter for multi-node scaling.
- **Clock Engine**: Adaptive NTP (Network Time Protocol) client-server burst measurement with exponential moving average (EWMA) drift correction.
- **Data & Storage**: PostgreSQL (Lakebase / Neon) with Prisma ORM.
